whatsNew.en:
🚀 InstaFuse v5.5 — What's New

💎 Added Liquid Glass Bottom Tab Bar
🎨 Added Liquid Glass Customisation
📱 Liquid Glass is available on Android 13+ only

📞 Added Call Recording for audio calls
🎵 Added Custom Story Audio — pick any audio or music directly from your local storage
🟢 Added Online Toast — get a popup when your friend comes online
👥 Added Follow Indicator in Followers and Following lists to easily see who follows you without opening their profile
🔤 Added Advanced Custom Story Fonts
📥 Added Bulk Font Download for story fonts
📋 Added Saved Copies in Quick Menu and Settings — check your copied bios, comments, captions and more
⚙️ Added a New InstaFuse Settings Design
🔎 Added Settings Search to quickly find any InstaFuse setting
🧪 Added Experimental Settings
⚡ Added Quick Access to InstaFuse Settings directly from your profile
🎨 Added new Liquid Glass customisation options
📦 Updated app base to 439.0.0.37.89

🔥 More exciting features and improvements are coming soon!

📥 Download link:
https://InstaFuse.vercel.app
